summary.headline: Jupiter’s Combustion in Three Signs
summary.text: Astrological prognoses for the combustion of Jupiter in Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, covering grain, weather, disease, mortality, prices, rulers, enemies, and regional conditions. The text also gives modifying effects when Saturn, Mars, Venus, Mercury, or the Moon is conjunct or aspecting Jupiter.
